# Log Router module

This module supports provisioning the following:

* **IBM Cloud Logs Routing**
  * Use IBM Cloud® Logs Routing to configure the routing of platform logs generated in your IBM Cloud account.
  * IBM Cloud Logs Routing is a platform service to manage platform logs at the account level by configuring targets and routes that define where log data is routed.
  * IBM Cloud Logs Routing actively manages logs generated by supported IBM Cloud services. Visit [here](https://cloud.ibm.com/docs/logs-router?topic=logs-router-cloud-services) to see the list of services that have adopted IBM Cloud Logs Routing.
  * IBM Cloud Logs Routing can route logs that are generated in supported regions. For more information, see [Locations](https://cloud.ibm.com/docs/logs-router?topic=logs-router-regions).

## Usage

```hcl
# Locals
locals {
  region = "us-south"
}

terraform {
  required_version = ">= 1.0.0"
  required_providers {
    ibm = {
      source  = "ibm-cloud/ibm"
      version = "X.Y.Z" # lock into a supported provider version
    }
  }
}
provider "ibm" {
  ibmcloud_api_key = XXXXXXXXXXXX #pragma: allowlist secret
  region           = local.region
}

# Create Log Router target and route
module "logs_router" {
  source  = "terraform-ibm-modules/cloud-logs/ibm//modules/logs_router"
  version = "X.Y.Z" # Replace "X.Y.Z" with a release version to lock into a specific release

  # Create Log Router target
  targets = [
    {
      # ID of the Cloud Logs instance
      destination_crn = "crn:v1:bluemix:public:logs:us-south:a/xxXXxxXXxXxXXXXxxXxxxXXXXxXXXXX:xxxxxx-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-xxxxxx::"
      target_name     = "my-cloud-logs-target"
      target_region   = "us-south"
    }
  ]
  routes = [
    {
      name = "my-lr-route"
      rules = [
        {
          action = "send"
          targets = [{
            id = module.logs_router.logs_router_targets["my-cloud-logs-target"].id
          }]
          inclusion_filters = [{
            operand  = "location"
            operator = "is"
            values   = ["us-south"]
          }]
        }
      ]
    }
  ]
}
```

### Required IAM access policies

You need the following permissions to run this module.

* Service
  * **Logs Routing** (Required if creating Log routes and targets)
    * `Editor` platform access
    * `Manager` service access
